Hi Claire,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the walkthrough of Zenlytics' real-time analytics workload and the primary SLOs (95th pct latency target, ~50 req/s steady-state, burst to 200). Per our conversation I ran an initial sizing and attached an estimate with two configuration options (Standard and Resilient) and expected monthly token / cost assumptions.

Quick summary:
- Recommended: Resilient config (multi-AZ, 2 reserved GPU workers, autoscale to 6) — better for burst headroom and KV cache retention.
- Estimated monthly token spend used for sizing: 25M tokens / mo (can be tuned).
- Pickup: Dedicated capacity gives predictable throughput and simpler SLO guarantees.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Review attached estimate (Redwood_Estimate_Zenlytics_v1.pdf)
2) Quick 30-min walkthrough to align on traffic assumptions and rollout plan
3) If it looks good, we can produce a one-page contract estimate and timetable

My available times this week:
- Tue 10/6 9:30–10:00am PT
- Wed 10/7 2:00–2:30pm PT
- Thu 10/8 11:00–11:30am PT

If none of those work, feel free to reply with a few windows or book directly: https://calendly.com/ben-redwood/15min

Attachment: Redwood_Estimate_Zenlytics_v1.pdf (PDF, 145 KB)

Best,
